metadata.question: Did the Alisal Fire cover less than 10,000 acres from October 11, 2021 to October 13, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: The Alisal Fire is a known wildfire in California (Santa Barbara County). I need to: - Identify the fire's location (approximately 34.5°N, -120°W based on historical records) - Use satellite imagery from October 11-13, 2021 - Look for burned area detection using Sentinel-2 or Landsat data - Calculate the burned area in acres 2. Masking strategy: I should NOT mask clouds for this analysis since burned areas are what we're detecting. I'll use spectral indices like NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) or NDVI to identify burned pixels, or use the difference in spectral signatures. 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero (B): If the fire covered 0-10,000 acres (answer is Yes) - Valid Non-Zero (A): If the fire covered >10,000 acres (answer is No) - C1: No imagery available for the date range - C2: No valid pixels detected (unlikely for a major fire) - C3: Calculation failed (null/NaN results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Alisal Fire location (Santa Barbara County, CA) const fireLocation = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.08, 34.51]); const aoi = fireLocation.buffer(15000); // ~15 km buffer to capture fire area // Date range: October 11-13, 2021 const startDate = '2021-10-11'; const endDate = '2021-10-13'; // Get Sentinel-2 imagery let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); let size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 Images (Oct 11-13, 2021): ${size}`); if (size === 0) { // Try Landsat 8 col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 Images (fallback): ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // Get pre-fire baseline (late September 2021) const preFireCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2021-09-20', '2021-10-05') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); if (preFireCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No pre-fire imagery for comparison'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) for fire period const fireImg = col.median(); const preFireImg = preFireCol.median(); // NBR = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR) // For Sentinel-2: Band 8a (NIR), Band 12 (SWIR2) const nbrFire = fireImg.normalizedDifference(['B8A', 'B12']).rename('NBR'); const nbrPre = preFireImg.normalizedDifference(['B8A', 'B12']).rename('NBR'); // dNBR = Pre-fire NBR - Post-fire NBR (positive values indicate burn) const dNBR = nbrPre.subtract(nbrFire).rename('dNBR'); // Burned area threshold: dNBR > 0.27 is considered moderate to high severity burn const burnedMask = dNBR.gt(0.27); // Count burned pixels const pixelArea = fireImg.select('B2').projection().nominalScale().pow(2).divide(1e6); // in km² const burnedPixels = burnedMask .reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=aoi, scale=20, maxPixels=1e9 ) .get('constant'); const burnedPixelsInfo = burnedPixels.getInfo(); console.log(`Burned pixels detected: ${burnedPixelsInfo}`); if (burnedPixelsInfo === null || burnedPixelsInfo === 0) { console.log('No significant burned area detected'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate burned area in acres (1 km² = 247.105 acres, pixel = 400 m² = 0.0004 km²) const burnedAreaKm2 = burnedPixelsInfo * 0.0004; const burnedAreaAcres = burnedAreaKm2 * 247.105; console.log(`Burned Area (Oct 11-13, 2021): ${burnedAreaKm2.toFixed(2)} km² = ${burnedAreaAcres.toFixed(0)} acres`); // Validate: Alisal Fire was actually ~17,062 acres by Oct 13 if (burnedAreaAcres < 10000) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
